notice.title: Handle these credentials with care
notice.body: Only literal values are masked: use no_log: true on tasks that transform or print secrets, because their output is kept in the history. Anyone who edits or runs a playbook can read the secrets its connection allows, so give each identity least-privilege access in Infisical.

empty.title: No connections
empty.description: Add a connection to declare secrets in your playbooks.

form.description: Universal Auth credentials of an Infisical machine identity.
form.client_secret_keep_hint: Leave empty to keep the current one.
form.project_id_hint: A connection reads from one project. Find it in Project Settings in Infisical.

toast.delete_error: Could not delete the connection. Check that no job or playbook uses it.

declaration.title: Infisical secrets
declaration.description: Declare the secrets this playbook needs and use them like any variable: {{example}}. The runner reads them before each run and they are never stored here.
declaration.environment_hint: Each run or job can choose another.
declaration.no_connection_hint: Without a connection, the playbook has no secrets.
